conditions: Must be a channel (a Slack channel object, not a DM or multi-person DM)
The workspace owner must be a current member of the channel
The channel must currently (at the time of the request) have exactly four members
Among channels satisfying the owner-membership and member-count conditions, it must be the one with the most recent creation timestamp
The channel should not already be archived, since archiving it is the requested action

readings: The single Primary Owner of the workspace
Any user holding Owner-level role status, if the workspace has multiple owners
Any conversation-like object including multi-person direct messages or shared channels
